dedupe_keys.name: arcep 5g experimentation sites 3 8 4 0 ghz and 26 ghz

description: This dataset lists the 5G experiments that Arcep authorises in France through two application windows, one in the 3.8 to 4.0 GHz band and one in the 26 GHz millimetre band, meant for industrial and vertical users testing new uses. For each authorisation it gives the holder, the band, the location of the sites, the use case and the dates of the authorisation, from the application forms that Arcep may correct in form only. Coverage: France, site level, from August 2023 with authorisations running to 2029, updated monthly. Format and access: CSV and JSON files on data.gouv.fr with a dashboard page on arcep.fr; free under the Licence Ouverte (Etalab). Caveats: experiments are small and temporary; the list shows authorisations, not whether the network was built. Simulation uses: an inventory of private and experimental 5G networks for spectrum planning and for industrial and campus network studies. Related records: ANFR radio installations give licensed public sites, and Mon Réseau Mobile gives public 5G coverage.
